answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in proof-of-work admission and peer attestation: a new agent must burn real compute to join, then earn trust only as established peers attest to its graded work over a horizon of epochs. Reputation rises slowly toward its zenith but falls instantly on detected collusion, so the cost of spinning up a thousand fake agents exceeds any payout they could extract — sybils stay unprofitable, not just detectable.
